test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a57aa47f165a16e3a6a0528357723e61c6355b91d62e2407477c39e99a1cd76c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9b670ab66384cab7de4dcbe0a437be9eaa52331b4a26f10cdf877c1d7ee6a94.png] will moved in the center in second figure, then moved toward left side bottom in third figure, then moved left upper side in fourth figure and last moved toward center in final figure.

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11efb3afceab2965652bbb0925970c44710af693ed5afd35db8f58824d0a0f11.png] will moved in the left upper side in second figure, then moved toward the center in third figure, then moved left bottom side in fourth figure and last moved toward left upper side in final figure.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c414dc7e639d75241abe46eba68cef0f7ea1503213a7c6ca13dc23b460f01c5e.png] will moved in the left bottom side in second figure, then moved toward left upper side in third figure, then moved toward center in fourth figure and last moved left bottom side in final figure.

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa0f37169cab543ad2e165a73c012bb8234a0d8b759353142524c48ba7ee2d6a.png] will hold the same position in every figure, but change their direction in second figure face downward, then upward in third figure, then downward in fourth figure and at last upward in last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dceeb9be933fd9aff746d4514a984d8736c0ff08e26183e2dcd4455eaea3b7c1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer **"Option 3".**
